Name: Quaint Living - Iris Garden
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center]This mod adds 9 irises from Quaint Living - Flower Garden to the game sold by Pierre. 

Please do not install this mod if you already have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15107/]Quaint Living - Flower Garden.
[/url]

[img=center]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15160/15160-1674434609-2040689845.png[/img]


Happy gardening![/center]
[line][b]
List of flowers added:[/b][line]

Spring:
[spoiler]
* Fairy Iris (Jas 2H)
* Gypsy Beauty Iris (Year 2)
* Lavender Silk Iris
[/spoiler]

Summer:
[spoiler]
* Gem Sea Iris (Year 2)
* Gotoroan Iris
* Pink Parfait Iris (Year 3)
* Sweet Musette Iris (Penny 6H)
[/spoiler]

Fall:
[spoiler]
* Dracula's Kiss Iris
* Fairy Iris (Jas 2H)
* Gotoroan Iris
[/spoiler]
[b]
[line]
Notes:[/b][line]
* This mod is intended for those who don't wish to install Quaint Living - Flower Garden but want the irises.
* Some of the irises are intentionally made to be only available in year 2 and 3. If you want to unlock them earlier, feel free to edit the crop.json inside each of the roses folders for your personal use.
* The name of most of the flowers included in this mod are true to their real-life counterpart, while the remaining few are modified for compatibility with other mods, or simply to make the names fit with the Stardew Valley vibe in general.
